summary: This is a routine annual general meeting notice and proxy statement filed by GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc. on Form 6-K. It sets the date, time, and location of the 2026 AGM, proposes the election of three Class II directors, and the ratification of the independent auditor. There are no special-situation transactions, no price terms, no stakeholder conflicts, no advisor roles, and no structural or regulatory hurdles beyond ordinary corporate governance. This is purely a standard procedural filing with no deal or corporate action requiring event-driven classification.
